author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads syslog from an OpenVPN 2.x server in multi-client mode, sent to the data collector. Completed connections, wrong user names or passwords, refused client certificates and disconnects go to Auth.
notes:
Setup:
- The OpenVPN 2.x server runs in multi-client mode, logging to syslog (--syslog, or a daemon whose journal the host forwards).
- The connection line names the certificate common name: with a client certificate shared by many users, add username-as-common-name so it names the user, because the Username/Password succeeded line isn't normalized (it would count each login twice).

Field mapping:
- Completed connections, wrong user names or passwords, refused client certificates and disconnects go to Auth; other lines are left to the parsers already in the tenant.

Time:
- The BSD syslog time has no year or zone and is read as UTC.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples are made up in the formats OpenVPN 2.6's source writes.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13.

Known gaps:
- IPv4 clients only.
